image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a single daisy flower head. The flower features a prominent yellow central disc composed of many small florets and is surrounded by white ray petals. The petals show some signs of wilting or browning at the tips and bases. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green, suggesting foliage.
